text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break, I saw El 
Condor Pasa in costume, striking a 
fighting pose full of competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wataaah!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Trainer! I put on my outfit and 
pumped myself up, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Doing this gets my spirits soaaaring, 
YEEES! ACHA—!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What's this, what's this?! Those 
clothes... are you a hero?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: H-Hero?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, this is the formal attire of a Condor 
Monk! I am not a hero, no!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Then... a villain costume?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Are you asking if I'm a técnico or a rudo? 
In that case, I'm aiming to be a righteous 
técnico!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, the villain Rude is an important 
part of getting the audience fired up, 
too, YES.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You get it, don't you! A hero is 
only as good as a great villain, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! It's precisely because both good 
and evil have such fiery passions that 
legendary battles are born!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! Do you have a special 
move or something?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! In addition to the aerial 
techniques passed down from Papa, there 
are also ones El devised herself, desu!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Midair combat techniques! Sounds so cool! 
What kind of villain are we fighting? 
Who's our partner in battle?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect them to bite so 
aggressively...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see you are quite the fan! El can't 
afford to lose either!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, how can we convey El's true 
passion...?!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Yes! Please, let's do this 
deeesu!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What's happening, what's happening!? Is a 
villain appearing!? Or is it a second 
hero!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! I want Trainer-san to tell 
everyone just how passionate El is!
choice_data_list: Let's show it through actions, not words!

You've got a passion as hot as your 
outfit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's not it! I want Trainer-san to tell 
everyone just how passionate El is!
choice_data_list: Let's show it through actions, not words!

You've got a passion as hot as your 
outfit.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Sí! Leave it to me, yeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...So what am I supposed to do?
choice_data_list: Allow me to demonstrate my signature kata!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see! Allow me to show you! El's 
scorching dance!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha! Did you see that?! The true 
essence of Condor Martial Arts!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So that's Condor Monk's special move...! 
That was so freaking cool!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Well, I am that good, but keep 
the compliments coming, deee-su! Ahaha~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That was so much fun! It's been so 
long since I've seen such a fiery special 
move!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, let's hang out and chat 
again sometime!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With pleasure! I am always happy to 
listen, deesu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa's passion seemed to have 
reached Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And from that day on, she began receiving 
frequent invitations from Biko Pegasus to 
hero shows.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...That is precisely it, YES!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So... like a flame robot or something?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Geh?! I don't have a robot, desu?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Could it be there's a second phase!? 
A flaming powered-up form!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It feels like we haven't been on the same 
page for a while now...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gah! I completely understand Biko's 
passion, desu! El must match that fiery 
spirit with everything she's got!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! In the face of such fiery passion, 
a few differences here and there don't 
matter at aaaaall!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but that line you 
just said sounded so cool!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding dong dang dong)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah... Lunch break is over already, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It was so fun passionately talking about 
heroes with you! Let's chat again! See ya!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Biko... You possess a burning passion that 
is quite different from El's, desu ne...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I simply cannot afford to lose, desu...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Moved by Biko Pegasus's fiery passion, El 
Condor Pasa renewed her determination... 
maybe?
